propositions: The deployed Gerrit review bot must load and execute the project.review-phase-boundaries criterion through its real four-pass webhook-to-checkout-to-prompt pipeline, not via offline mock.
A positive-control patchset with valid phase-boundary discovery refinement must emit no finding, demonstrating correct criterion abstention on valid stimuli.

The predeclared RP-F2 FIRE-control patchset must produce a project-attributed advisory finding with reviewer_id code-review-project-review-phase-boundaries and matching Pass-2/Pass-3 routing attributes at blocking_enabled=false and block_threshold=0.90.
The final cleaned patchset must contain only phase-compliant instructions, emit no project-criterion finding, and land on main as the sole submitted revision of the dogfood change.
